def solve(grid, bg_marker=1, fill=3):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    for i in range(h):
        cols=[j for j in range(w) if g[i][j]==bg_marker]

    for j in range(w):
        rows=[i for i in range(h) if g[i][j]==bg_marker]
        for a,b in zip(rows,rows[1:]):

                for i in range(a+1,b): g[i][j]=fill
    return g
